prompt.helper: Choose a family to help. You can only help one family at a time.

prompt.step_4: How many people live in your household? Type the number and press check.

prompt.step_6: Please type your correct account number. Check it carefully before you press continue.

prompt.step_8_waiting: Your claim is saved on your phone. It will be sent when you have signal.

queue.sub: Highest priority first. When priority is equal, the least sure case comes first. Updates every 10 seconds.
queue.empty: No cases are waiting. Well done.

helper.planned_body: After every payout, an automatic AI voice call would phone each woman who was paid and ask: press 1 if you received the full amount, press 2 if the helper or agent took or asked for any money. If a complaint is confirmed, the helper is removed from the programme and fined a very large sum.

prompt.verifying: Our people are checking your claim now. Please wait.
tour.title: Watch first
tour.badge: Practice: made-up details. Nothing is sent.
prompt.demo_2: This page asks for your permission. The office will see your name, ID number and household. You can take your permission back at any time. When you are ready, press the green button, I agree. Watch first, then you do it.
prompt.demo_3: Type your ID card number with the big buttons. Then press, Find my record. We will show a name. If it is your name, press Yes. This is only practice with a made-up number. Now you do it with your own number.
prompt.demo_4: Count how many people live in your household. Type the number with the big buttons. Then press, Check. This is only practice. Now you do it with your own number.
prompt.demo_5: Now we need photos of your ID card. Press, Take a photo, and hold the phone steady in good light. If the photo is already on the phone, press, Choose a photo. When you see, Photo received, do the back of the card the same way. This is only practice. Now you do it with your own card.
prompt.demo_6: Type your mobile account number with the big buttons. It has 11 numbers and starts with zero three. Check it carefully, then press Continue. Never tell anyone your secret PIN. This is only practice with a made-up number.
prompt.demo_7: This page shows what you are sending. Look at it. When it is right, press the green button, Send my claim. Then the computer or a staff member checks it, and the answer comes on your screen.
